private_storage.required: single-writer local persistent encrypted filesystem, initially 40 GiB; no SQLite WAL over a network filesystem
private_storage.backup: private versioned cloud object bucket, encrypted, separately scoped identity; verify restore on a replacement cloud instance
private_storage.current_control: 6 GiB monitored pilot tree plus 6 GiB free reserve; polling is not a hard filesystem quota

private_ingress.required: hosted HTTPS gateway with OIDC or equivalent identity allowlist; block unauthenticated access to every route
private_ingress.application_auth: separate RADAR_API_TOKEN from the cloud secret manager, never mounted into the collector

billing.caveat: Existing session resource consumption is subject to the user's platform plan; no new billable infrastructure or model call requested

required_platform_operations_unavailable: apply configuration to the task instance or create/rebind a reviewed instance
provision private persistent cloud storage and scoped backup identity
